ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, a right-angled triangle ruler with an angle of $45^\circ$ is placed on two parallel lines $m$ and $n$. If $\angle \alpha = 118^\circ$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle \beta$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, \\
$\because m\parallel n$, \\
$\therefore \angle 1=\angle 2$, \\
$\because \angle \alpha =\angle 2+\angle A$, \\
and $\angle A=45^\circ$, $\angle \alpha =118^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle 2=118^\circ-45^\circ=73^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle 1=73^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle \beta =\boxed{73^\circ}$.
